components.name: HealthWallet.me (Android)
components.requirements: Android 10 or later with Chrome 141 or later
components.description: Open-source, offline-first patient health wallet with on-device AI. Holds FHIR R4 records synced from US providers or extracted locally from scanned documents.
components.testPatient: John Doe (synthetic, born 1985-03-15) from the app's built-in demo dataset: allergies, medications, immunizations, procedures, observations, goals, a clinical document, and a Coverage resource.
components.notes: SMART Health Check-in support is in development for the November 2026 connectathon; status will change to up once a build that answers check-in requests is on the Play Store. Load the demo patient from onboarding (Load Demo Data). Source: https://github.com/LifeValue/HealthWallet.me
